Class GameMap

java.lang.Object
logic.map.GameMap
public class GameMap extends Object
Mutable map model containing grid tiles, build decorations, and computed path waypoints.

Tile encoding: { 0}=grass, { 1}=path, { 2}=castle.

  • Method Details

    • generatePath

      public List<Waypoint> generatePath()
      Builds an ordered path from a border path tile (1) to castle (2) via BFS. If no castle path is found, falls back to generateWaypointsFromGrid(int).

    • getCastleBaseCell

      public int[] getCastleBaseCell()

      Returns:
      the castle base cell (2), or null if none

    • isCastleClearanceTile

      public static boolean isCastleClearanceTile(int row, int col, int castleR, int castleC)
      Checks if a tile is within the 3x2 clearance zone aligned with castle rendering. Clearance zone: rows castleR-1..castleR, cols castleC-1..castleC+1.
      Parameters:
      row - the row to check
      col - the column to check
      castleR - the castle's base row
      castleC - the castle's base column
      Returns:
      true if within clearance, false otherwise

    • isInCastleClearanceZone

      col - the column to check
      Returns:
      true if within clearance zone, false otherwise
